name: Eliab (Gadite)
title: A Gadite warrior of David
summary: Eliab was one of the brave Gadite warriors who joined David in the wilderness. These men could wield both shield and spear, were as swift as gazelles and as bold as lions.

keyEvents.title: A Gadite warrior of David
keyEvents.description: Eliab was among the Gadite heroes who came to David in the wilderness and took his side.
